title: Para Bellum content: research bureaus
description: File: Content/<namespace>/bureau.json. The design bureaus, suppliers and producers that lead and build research projects. Every authored bureau ships; the roster cut is the active flag, never a deletion. An ACTIVE bureau carries a positive capacity: the most labs it may lead on one project (D3). An active bureau with a null capacity is a missing required value, C101, checked beside the schema.

home.description: Where the bureau is: the place and its coordinates AS AUTHORED (facts, checkable against history; integer MICRODEGREES, since every number in content is an integer, C103), and the province DERIVED from them, side by side so a near-border miss is visible. province is null when no province reaches the point; the bureau still exists. null for a bureau with no home (only an inactive one may lack it).
